test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 24 Dec, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Plant cells have cell walls because _______.

options.text: they defend plant cells from a variety of external effects
they do not have proper genetic material

solution:
The Correct answer is __**they defend plant cells from a variety of external effects**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Plant cells** have a rigid cell wall that provides **structural support** and protection.
 
• The **cell wall** is composed of **cellulose**, hemicellulose, and pectin.
 
• It acts as a **barrier** against mechanical stress and pathogens.
 
• The cell wall helps in maintaining the **shape** of the cell and prevents excessive water intake.
 
• It also plays a role in the **transport of substances** in and out of the cell.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **required for photosynthesis**__

 __
 
• Photosynthesis primarily occurs in the **chloroplasts**, not the cell wall.
 
 
 
• **do not have cytoplasm**__
 __
 
• Plant cells **do have cytoplasm**, which is essential for cellular processes.
 
 
 
• **do not have proper genetic material**__
 
 
• Plant cells contain a **nucleus** that holds their **genetic material**.
